chapter: Later ventures, lodges and San Francisco recollections
title: Partner Syd Carter in the first music store
summary: Carter was a clarinetist and former medicine-show bandmaster who partnered in the store for two years before being bought out.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Who were the great clarinetists? Favorites and rivals

blocks.x: When you opened the music store--the first one-- Spikes Brothers, you had a partner named Syd Carter?

He played tr...he played clarinet. He had a been a bandmaster for Ferdon--Ferdon Medical. You know they used to have medicine shows and they'd have a band, and he was with him for years. And then he...we opened the music store but after a couple of years or so, he got...he wanted to go back to Ferdon, so we bought him out, and he went back and stayed two...three years, then he retired.
